physicalQuestion: Does a constant-radius rack pinion driving a scissor lift produce decreasing height increments for equal horizontal rack steps, while the deck stays level and returns to datum?

motorRoles.role: Drive the single horizontal rack; the scissor and deck remain mechanically constrained passive outputs.

datumAndSign.directionStatus: Geometric sign -1 confirmed by the first native DEVELOPMENT probe; exact final-byte formal qualification remains PENDING.
datumAndSign.formula: inward rack displacement s = direction * encoderDegrees * pi/180 * 6 mm; ideal h = sqrt(80^2 - (64-s)^2) mm
datumAndSign.manualReset: Reload or reset the saved LDR pose before running after manual movement. Program never rewrites the encoder datum.

observationPoints.status: Final semantic points verified against the exact exported source placements and unique native body ownership.
observationPoints.coordinates: All local LDU marker points are transformed by actual imported body poses, then expressed relative to the observed chassis using observeAddon. That helper returns the INITIAL IMPORTED WORLD orientation, which can differ from source LDraw axes after mat placement. Derive a fixed orthonormal basis from observeAddon.initial(bottom_housing, localAxis) minus observeAddon.initial(bottom_housing, [0,0,0]); normalize each. Use housing local +X for width, -Y for up, and -Z for lateral. This basis is independent of commanded and observed output motion. The fork lies at source Z=-80 while rack axle marker Z=0; never normalize bottom-minus-origin as the width axis.

measurementDefinitions.topWidth: 1000 * dot(topSlider - deck, horizontalUnit), independent passive-slider check.
measurementDefinitions.deckDrift: Range of the chassis-relative deck-minus-origin projections on horizontalUnit and lateralUnit; each below 1 mm.
measurementDefinitions.return: Euclidean displacement between actual final and first chassis-relative deck marker points.
measurementDefinitions.deckTilt: Angle between actual deck up vector and the fixed chassis-referenced initial up unit vector.
measurementDefinitions.chassisTilt: Actual chassis attitude change from its saved imported pose; no fixed chassis substitution.

qualificationEnvelopeIncludingOvershoot.meaning: Recorded poses must remain within the full 116..164 LDU guard. Clearance of physically reachable poses in that guard must be checked. Nominal physical stops bound positive-branch width to 115..160 LDU: the reachable intersection is 116..160 LDU. Analytically generated 160..164 LDU poses place the deck below its deliberate rests and are not reachable nonpenetrating configurations; retain their contact diagnosis rather than treating them as free clearance. This guard is not itself a physical stop.

physicalStopsAndRetention.status: Geometry-owner identities and nominal bounds frozen; exact mesh contact and final native contact evidence must be recorded separately before a construction PASS. Nominal bounds are not overstated as measured physical-build tolerances.
physicalStopsAndRetention.boundsStatus: Nominal ideal-closure/native-collider bounds, subject to actual mesh/contact confirmation.

maximumWidthRest.behavior: Nonpenetrating landing contact keeps height at least 120 LDU on the positive scissor branch and therefore width at most 160 LDU. No b0/b4 collision suppression. Widths above 160 are below-rest analytic penetrations, not reachable clearance poses.

minimumWidthStop.contactEnabling: Both axle/stop pairs explicitly use noCollideParts mode collide; no global collision disabling.
minimumWidthStop.meshContactStatus: PENDING geometry-owner exact mesh/contact confirmation; do not claim native box face is exact LDraw surface.

retentionRequirements: Check actual shaft/pin occupied intervals, support, collars/bushes, shared ownership, and engagement at both physical-stop bounds and tight intermediate poses.
Retain upper and lower racks within their physical guides throughout 115..160 LDU nominal reachable travel.
Check same-body meshes and moving-body clearance; exact intended pin/hole or stop contact is reviewed pairwise, never excused by blanket issue suppression.
physicalStopsAndRetention.freeRelease: Cold physical-rest behavior is required at the saved lower pose. No claim of arbitrary unpowered-position holding, payload capacity or manual travel outside the stated bounds.
physicalStopsAndRetention.coverage: Construction sweep should cover nominal physical 115..160 LDU including both stop endpoints, plus 116..160 LDU reachable qualification guard. Guard segment 160..164 LDU is an explicit deliberate-rest penetration diagnosis, not a sweep pass.
physicalStopsAndRetention.note: Software limits are not physical stops. Final construction evidence must distinguish exact mesh facts, conservative colliders, contact exclusions, and unresolved pairs.

singularities.flat: w=80 mm, h=0: collapsed toggle, force demand diverges in ideal rigid frictionless model. Outside commanded and qualification ranges.
singularities.vertical: w=0 mm, h=80 mm: vertical branch limit, outside commanded and qualification ranges.
singularities.branch: Positive height branch; all actual linkage closures and retained slider engagement must be verified.

execution.runtime: registered Creator -> SB3 -> real Scratch VM -> bundled robotlab extension -> Robot Lab API -> measured-feedback motor controller -> Jolt
execution.coldDefinitionStatus: Preregistered before the first native probe: 1000 ms unpowered startup and actual deck-height span below 0.5 mm. Final geometry supplies the declared physical landing rests.
execution.lifecycleScope: Fixed-session native programme only. No scene reset/load/stop/start lifecycle or virtual-hub transport claim.
execution.finish: Motor A hold captures attained angle; program checks arrival and return, then holds.
execution.timeLimitMeaning: 90000 ms of programme execution, excluding the declared 1000 ms cold interval and 1000 ms after interval.

finiteProgram.durationOrigin: Green flag after cold interval; finishedAt minus coldMs must be less than 90000 ms.

nativeTravel.returnMetric: Euclidean displacement between actual first and final chassis-relative deck marker points, not a substituted ideal height.
nativeTravel.minimumActualRiseMetric: Stage-4 mean measured height minus stage-0 mean measured height; at least 15 mm.
nativeTravel.topBottomWidthCoherenceMetric: Absolute difference between independently observed topSlider-minus-deck width and bottom-minus-origin width, both projected on the fixed chassis width axis; every recorded sample below 0.5 mm.

acceptance.heightRelation: At each observed pose, independently measure w and h from real marker points, then compare h with sqrt(80^2-w^2). No motor-angle-derived output poses.

stageObservation.heightIncrements: Each of the four measured upward height increments from stages 0 through 4 is positive and smaller than the preceding increment. Preserve all measured values.
stageObservation.settledWidthReference: Each stage actual mean width vs 64 - 6 * direction * targetDegrees * pi/180; use expected stage widths independently from route as well.
stageObservation.routeConsistency: Recorded targets and direction must agree with the fixed contract route independently of the target-derived width formula; observed stage order is monotone through all stages 0..8.

acceptance.allSamples: All observed body and joint poses and derived measured scalars finite; marker ownership unambiguous; each native track nonempty; no static/frozen chassis substitution. The coordinate-frame part must have unique ownership on the chassis body.

coldBehavior.measurement: Actual chassis-relative deck height throughout the unpowered pre-green-flag interval; all other finite, closure, tilt and envelope gates still apply.
coldBehavior.coverage: The declared 1000 ms cold interval must be present at the requested 30 Hz sampling; absence or inadequate coverage fails rather than bypassing the cold check.

acceptance.negativeObserver: Frozen passive deck recording must fail physical rise or height-relation judge; this is an observer test, not a physical run.

originalPhysicalJoints.lockedHingeIssues: Only exact geometry-owner-reviewed part sets in markers.approvedIssues can be accepted; blanket issue-code allowance prohibited.
originalPhysicalJoints.measurement: Observe closure at all 13 physical metadata hinge interfaces, including both front/rear supports and the drive bearing, using part-local shared connector anchors carried by actual bodies. Include compiled motor hinge j0 separately. Representative compiled hinge gaps and axes remain additional checks.

acceptance.afterCoverage: The declared 1000 ms after interval must be present at the requested 30 Hz sampling; absence or inadequate coverage fails.

constructionAcceptance.rotations: All finite proper row-major R: R^T R approximately I, determinant approximately +1.
constructionAcceptance.interfaces: Hole centers/types/axes/thicknesses and occupied shaft/pin intervals, key phase, shared-fastener owner and retention explicitly documented.
constructionAcceptance.clearance: Check same-body intersections and moving links over the full physically reachable declared domain with finite tolerances, including exact stop-contact boundaries; record unreachable analytic penetrations and every unresolved pair separately. Numerical pass thresholds are unchanged.
constructionAcceptance.physics: Report exact bodies/joints/couplings/friction/diagnostics, any inferred parts or hinge-to-ball substitutions; evaluate original physical closures as well.

claimLimits: All height and force numbers in initial lessons are ideal predictions until checked against final exported bytes.
Rack force relation ignores friction, inertia, compliance, gear losses and motor limits; no payload lifting-capacity claim.
Physical LEGO build, browser UI, app integration and hardware firmware remain separate UNTESTED layers until actually exercised.
revisionPolicy: Preserve failed records and original criteria. A revised design/contract gets a new revision and new qualification; never relabel a failed run by silently weakening thresholds.
